pages.title: Hilbert Brick
pages.text: Brick moulded to the standards of Hilbert's programme: every face a rigorous statement, every joint a valid inference. A wall built from it is a formal system, and it feels reassuringly complete until I remember Godel.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pulled from the walls of the Hilbert archive. Each brick is stamped with axioms in small, careful script, so I started stacking them for my own records. Ground down, they yield axiom schemata.
Made in $(item)Formal Proof Assistant$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiom Schema, Hilbert Locker, Hilbert's Hotel Key.
